title: FinNLI: Novel Dataset for Multi-Genre Financial Natural Language Inference Benchmarking

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating z-statistics for task-independent features (such as unigrams, bigrams, premise-hypothesis length ratio, and lexical overlap) to identify and filter out artifacts that are highly correlated with specific NLI class labels.
Comparing an LLM's (Llama 3.1 70B) classification performance on a test set generated by itself versus its performance on a test set generated by a different model (GPT-4).
